affected_modules: F2-WP-800 ObservationView/evaluator separation reused as benchmark boundary
best_supported_delta: treat goal inference as benchmark posterior/hypothesis, never goal authority
consume exact public ObservationView plus immutable public candidate-goal descriptors only
seal inference before evaluator label access
make UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN first-class for observationally non-identifiable cases
report coverage plus selective risk rather than answered-case accuracy alone
keep goal inference distinct from next-observation/world-model prediction
make priors explicit and score prior-only versus evidence-driven behavior separately
hold out causal/generative families, not only episode IDs
cap classical inverse-planning/cost baselines to the same public-information capability surface as the SUT
recommended_falsifiers: observationally equivalent two-goal fixture should yield UNKNOWN
matched identifiable fixture prevents universal abstention from looking strong
hidden-leak sentinel where evaluator-only field predicts label but public evidence does not
simple deterministic public baseline versus richer inverse-planning method
